objective: Completar en una sola ejecucion el detalle ISCAM pendiente de 130MID desde 2026-07-07 hasta 2026-08-01 exclusivo. El backfill canonico debe recorrer internamente cada dia, omitir los ya conciliados, insertar solo dias OK_HEADER_CANONICO y reportar cualquier bloqueado sin regrabar encabezados.

queries.name: 130mid_julio_range_parity
queries.sql:
WITH dias AS (
  SELECT CAST('2026-07-07' AS date) d
  UNION ALL SELECT DATEADD(day,1,d) FROM dias WHERE d<'2026-07-31'
), r AS (
  SELECT fecha_operacion,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-07-07' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-01'
  GROUP BY fecha_operacion
), dt AS (
  SELECT fecha_operacion,numero_ticket,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta,
         MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-07-07' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-01'
    AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
  GROUP BY fecha_operacion,numero_ticket
), d AS (
  SELECT fecha_operacion,CAST(ISNULL(SUM(venta),0) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,COUNT_BIG(*) tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dt GROUP BY fecha_operacion
)
SELECT dias.d fecha,
       CAST(ISNULL(r.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_encabezado,
       CAST(ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_detalle,
       CAST(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) delta_ventas,
       ISNULL(r.tickets,0) tickets_encabezado,ISNULL(d.tickets,0) tickets_detalle,
       ISNULL(r.tickets,0)-ISNULL(d.tickets,0) delta_tickets,
       ISNULL(r.pax,0) pax_encabezado,ISNULL(d.pax,0) pax_detalle,
       ISNULL(r.pax,0)-ISNULL(d.pax,0) delta_pax,
       CASE WHEN ABS(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas,0))<=0.05
         AND ISNULL(r.tickets,0)=ISNULL(d.tickets,0)
         AND ISNULL(r.pax,0)=ISNULL(d.pax,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END parity_gate
FROM dias
LEFT JOIN r ON r.fecha_operacion=dias.d
LEFT JOIN d ON d.fecha_operacion=dias.d
ORDER BY dias.d
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100)
